scripts.build: npm --workspace packages/shared run build && npm --workspaces --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace packages/shared run build && npm --workspaces --if-present run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm --workspace packages/shared run build && npm --workspaces --if-present test && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 'test/*.test.ts'
